provider: Telnyx Object Storage ($6/TB, zero metered egress)

free_tier.stated: 10 GiB of US storage, 1 million state-change (Class A) and 10 million state-read (Class B) operations free every month; US storage beyond it USD 0.006 per GiB a month; EU storage has no free tier and costs USD 0.025 per GiB a month
free_tier.notes: on the Trial account tier, Cloud Storage is limited to the documented free tier of used capacity, to non-public bucket and object policies or ACLs and to pre-signed URLs with a 5-minute TTL

retention.stated: no expiry is stated while available credit is positive; when available credit stays negative for 30 days the account is abolished and all data is irreversibly purged
retention.notes: the account suspension and loss of data section of the first-party billing documentation

egress.terms: the pay-as-you-go rate card lists Egress fees: None; reads are billed as state-read operations at USD 0.04 per million
egress.price_per_tb: none: the rate card lists no egress fee

tooling: AWS SDKs, AWS CLI and third-party S3 clients, authenticated with the Telnyx API key; buckets in us-central-1, us-east-1, us-west-1, eu-central-1, ap-southeast-1 and ca-central-1
chaining: S3-compatible origin with no egress fee on the rate card, billed per GiB stored and per million operations

limits.value: 10 GiB of US storage, 1 million state-change and 10 million state-read operations free a month; usage beyond them is billed, and EU storage has no free tier

limits_note: minimum billable object size 4 KiB, and metadata counts toward stored bytes; stored bytes are recorded hourly and debited from the account balance; while available credit is negative the free tier is unavailable and new buckets and uploads are refused

identity_cost.detail: reaching the Paid tier needs a verified email, a passed fraud review (LinkedIn or GitHub verification or an AI agent evaluation), a verified mobile number, a payment with a credit or debit card, 2FA and a Provided Service Address; the Trial tier needs only the verified email and the fraud review; the Verified tier adds KYC

reliability_note: with a negative available credit, data is retained but API requests fail with UserSuspended until a payment restores the credit; after 30 days of negative credit the account is abolished and all data is irreversibly purged
confidence_note: the rate card is quoted from the first-party pricing page, the free tier, regional prices, minimum object size and suspension terms from the first-party billing documentation, and the account tiers from the first-party developer documentation
